race.description: XXXX Gold Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIYAASI (4) produced a good effort when narrowly defeated last time at Narrandera over this trip when a firm fav. Gun hoop in Loy sticks. Can go one better. JUSTWATCHHER (9) struggled last time at Canberra Action after making a solid return there prior. Rise in trip suits third-up and he can improve sharply. MUCHOBOR (3) has been finding above average maiden winners throughout his debut prep but looks to have found a more suitable contest this time. Backs up quickly from the Sapphire Coast, will just need some luck from the tricky draw. BROKEN IMAGE (7) finds it tough to break through but is knocking on the door. Keeping safe.
